title: FileNode destroy cascades: -20 §5 undiscoverable-descendant check; deepest-first Space tree destroy
description: Found in spec-sync batch 2. (1) -20 §5: a destroy that would remove undiscoverable descendants through onDestroyRemoveChildren (and the onSuccessDestroyOriginal cascade) MUST be rejected with forbidden and destroy nothing; the plain cascades lack this check (also noted on JMAP-t8ej.30). (2) crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server destroy_space_file_tree still destroys parents first, though get_descendant_ids now promises parent-before-child order and the filenode-server handlers destroy deepest first (038b33cd/1a0185dd). (3) check_space_destroy: replace_existing checks only files_rights.mayDelete, which manage_channels grants for a Space root, but destroying the root needs manage_space.
